description.value: Natural Focus is a natural health products retailer that has been operating for 30 years, starting on Hastings Street in Burnaby and now based in Surrey. The store carries a broad selection of vitamins, supplements, protein, herbal products, and natural grocery items, available both in-store and online. A touring cyclist passing through could pick up natural snacks, protein supplements, and wellness staples from a well-stocked specialty health shop.

address.value: 6350 120th Street - Unit 131, Surrey, BC, Canada, V3X 3K1

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
